messages:
jess: Heads-up — pushing signed installer epoch42 (v2026.03.21) now. Artifact created and staged for private transport. Will kick off mirror+canary in the next 20m.

deploy-bot: artifact created: redwood-installer-epoch42.tgz by ci-packager-7
sha256: 9f3b2c4a3e8d6f1b5a6c7d8e9f1a2b3c4d5e6f7a8b9c0d1e2f3a4b5c6d7e8f9
cosign: signed (key: k8s://ci-signer-02)
manifest: s3://redwood-private/epochs/42/manifest.json

sam: Copying to local mirror (mirror-nyc-1) now — will run mirror-verify then start a 2-host canary. ETA ~15m.

oliver: Please pin the private manifest to epoch42 in release-manifest after canary passes. Also request: throttle deploy-bot to 10rps for first 30m as a guardrail.

jess: Ops prefers quiet window 02:00-03:00 UTC for any canary fiddling — can we target that? If not, keep canary shorter.

ana: @sam add extra retry/backoff for the mirror transport. Last time partial uploads caused a checksum mismatch during promotion.

deploy-bot: rc job created: rc-canary-epoch42 -> targets: vpc-cluster-1[2 nodes]; throttle=10rps; timeout=3600s

sam: mirror-verify: all checksums match. Command used: `sha256sum redwood-installer-epoch42.tgz` -> matches the CI artifact hash.

mike: I'll run cosign verify now: `cosign verify --key k8s://ci-signer-02 s3://.../redwood-installer-epoch42.tgz` — will post outcome.

oliver: If cosign verify fails we abort and pin back to epoch41 immediately. Also capture signer fingerprint in release notes.

jess: Agreed. Plan: 1) cosign verify -> 2) start deploy-bot canary -> 3) monitor for 15m -> 4) promote staged rollout (10% -> 30% -> 100%) if green. Rollback criteria: >5% error rate in canary, KV sync failure, or infra alerts. Rollback action: pin manifest to epoch41 + cancel promotions.

ana: I'll watch logs and configure alerts (ops-alerts channel) for latency regressions and grpc errors.

deploy-bot: canary started at 4032104600. rc-canary-epoch42 -> 2/2 targets updated. streaming logs available.

sam: Canary reports: 0 errors so far. p95 latency ~120ms, token cost unchanged. Starting staggered promotion plan: 10% -> wait 15m -> 30%.

jess: For airgapped customers: remember we must ship the signed submanifest bundle to escrow. @mike, can you package the submanifest + cosign sig and hand off to transport?

mike: Packaging done. submanifest path: /artifacts/epoch42/submanifest.tar.gz (cosign sig attached). Transport handoff scheduled for 03:45 UTC.

oliver: Post-update todo: Update installer docs with epoch/hash and a short note: "Epoch 42 — improves KV warmup for cold starts". Also add signer fingerprint reference.

deploy-bot: promote job scheduled: staggered rollout started 10% at 4032105020.

jess: I'll draft the release notes and push to release-notes repo. If anything weird during the staggered rollout ping me directly.

ana: Everything looks green from monitoring side. No errors and expected performance. Marking this thread as resolved once the 100% promotion completes.
